results.title: Antes de Você Eu Existia em Cores
results.original_title: Antes de Você Eu Existia em Cores
results.overview: Caught between the enchantment of a budding romance in the 1970s and the coldness of a marriage worn down by psychological abuse, Rosa faces the painful realization that loving Antônio meant losing herself along the way.

results.title: Until You Answer Me
results.overview: Lucia faces everyday challenges while trying to stretch her budget for her brother's birthday present. To afford it, she rents out a room, but her expected roommate vanishes without a trace. After learning about ongoing protests in Iran from a neighbor, Lucia finds out that unarrived guest is Iranian too and tries to call her.

results.title: Aqui Comem Os Pombos
results.overview: A young man spends a day at the beach, contemplating the sand, sea, and sky as he narrates his thoughts and memories. Through silence and fleeting moments, he reflects on loss, grief, longing, and the absence of someone he deeply loved.

results.title: Rinne für Rinne
results.overview: The trout farm on the Lachsbach survived the economic upheaval after the fall of the Berlin Wall. Traces of this change can be seen not only in the place, but also in its people. More than a generation later, the film explores what has remained and what has had to give way.

results.title: The Experiment
results.overview: Mat Fraser and Sophie Morgan invite members of the public to take part in a provocative experiment inside a brand new “progressive” residential facility. Visitors are encouraged to take a closer look, meet the residents, and discover a very different type of care. But as the experiment unfolds, nothing is quite as it seems. As events take an increasingly unsettling turn and troubling ideas begin to emerge, will anyone question what’s really going on?

results.title: The Oil in My Blood
results.overview: The Oil in My Blood, written as a fable to my daughter Mar, reimagines an oil platform as a sea monster confronting a mermaid. It reflects on promises of progress, Pemex’s exploitation, and Tabasco’s poisoned waters, where families endure precarious labor. Through memory and metaphor, it exposes how sacrifice sustains livelihoods while threatening land, sea, and future generations.

results.title: Das Institut für kurzfristige Wiederbelebung zur Aufklärung ungeklärter Erbschaftsangelegenheiten
results.original_title: Das Institut für kurzfristige Wiederbelebung zur Aufklärung ungeklärter Erbschaftsangelegenheiten
results.overview: Dying is usually a straightforward matter. Unless the will contains formal errors. In that case, the Institute for Short-Term Resuscitation for the Resolution of Unresolved Inheritance Matters steps in to resolve unsettled claims. But when spokesperson Dr. Kopalski’s sister suddenly finds herself in the chair, he has to decide: the institute or his sister? Life or death?

results.title: Gabriel
results.overview: When a young altar boy encounters the devil during a foot-washing ritual, he must confront the supposed incompatibility of his non-normative sexuality and his faith. Devotion, dominance, ecstasy and shame exist side by side in both cases, shaped by a longing for intimacy and acceptance.

results.title: Doïna
results.overview: Andrei is a Romanian expatriate living in France. One day, his mother Doïna visits him to confirm a gynecological diagnosis made in Romania. Forced to translate the conversation between her and the doctor during the examination, Andrei becomes the unwilling witness to his mother’s intimate history.

results.title: Carpe Diem
results.overview: Since Anna Weber gave the world the Carpe Diem Agreement, peace and prosperity have reigned on Earth. Everyone knows, down to the very last second, how much time they have left. When Anna’s own clock runs out, she is forced to realize that her husband David refuses to live out his remaining two years without her – thereby calling her entire life’s work into question.

results.title: Pelle – Freunde sinken nicht
results.overview: Pelle waits. He always has. At the end of the world stands his tower and waits with him. There isn’t much to do here, surrounded by the sea and ice and nothingness. Once a year, Ole the whale passes through and makes a rest stop with Pelle. But this year, Pelle can find no trace of his friend on the horizon. Not today. Not tomorrow either. And after such a long wait, he becomes impatient … with devastating consequences.

results.title: Tote Oma
results.overview: German Democratic Republic, 1989: Margot leads a quiet, orderly life with her party-loyal husband. Every day is the same between household chores, television and the same familiar rituals. In a world that promises her security and stability, the monotony of her daily life becomes increasingly noticeable. A young neighbor and a goldfish bring movement into Margot’s rigid routine.

results.title: DESVELADO
results.overview: An unnamed young man spends his sleepless nights in the bathtub. He smokes, lies motionless in the water, and tries to escape his thoughts. Time and again, they revolve around Ben, his lover. Ben enjoys his freedom and refuses any emotional intimacy. Their relationship is characterized by the fear of attachment and loss. In dreamlike sequences, the protagonist envisions a different life, yet he cannot escape his fears.

results.title: La promessa di Patrizio
results.overview: The real story of Patrizio Oliva, raised in an extended family in a difficult neighbourhood in Naples. After the loss of his brother Ciro, Patrizio decides to collect his legacy and fight for redeeming himself and his family.

results.title: Chris - Einfach nur leben
results.overview: Chris travels the world with no money – not to test limits, but out of a deep trust in life itself. On his journeys from Roetgen in the Eifel region to Jerusalem, through India and Japan, he is looking for connections, not possessions, and questions the conventions of work, religion and identity.

results.title: How to Remember
results.overview: In 2020s Berlin, 95-year-old Leonid Berezin, along with other surviving eyewitnesses, is fighting to keep alive the memory of a nearly forgotten Nazi war crime: at the age of twelve, he survived the Siege of Leningrad—the systematic starvation of what is now Saint Petersburg.

results.title: Kan Kardeşi - Those in Between
results.overview: A few meters from the UN buffer zone, Ayşegül and her best friend Adnan grow up in Lefkoşa, the Turkish-controlled half of Cyprus’s divided capital. From the rooftops, they gaze at the European south – close enough to touch and yet out of reach: as the daughter of Turkish settlers, Ayşegül cannot cross the border. She works at a supermarket and dreams of a life in France, while Adnan aspires to a career as a professional badminton player. But family expectations, Ayşegül’s engagement to her jealous ex-boyfriend, and Adnan’s military service test their friendship and plans for the future.

results.title: Lily Brett - Laughter Can Pierce Pain
results.original_title: Lily Brett - Lachen gegen das Grauen
results.overview: In 1948, a little girl sits smiling on a Parisian carousel – for the first time she experiences a moment of carefree childhood. Her parents are Holocaust survivors; Lily Brett was born just after the end of World War II in a DP camp in Feldafing. The writer Lily Brett artistically explores the trauma she inherited in a remarkable way, marked by gentle humor rather than bitterness or anger. Not as an accuser, but as a bridgebuilder.
